about: The question a quick answer is shown to answer (docs/api.md, A run that answers): the last sentence of the reply that ends in a question mark, else the last of its card's questions, else the reply's first twelve words. Markdown marks, links' addresses and code blocks are not part of it. The web page (public/app.js questionOf) and the apps (AnswerQuote.questionOf) are checked against these.
